newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austria to meet EMU criteria in 1997-FinMin.
newsitem.headline: Austria to meet EMU criteria in 1997-FinMin.

text.p: Austrian Finance Minister Viktor Klima said on Tuesday Austria would meet the Maastricht criteria for membership in Europe's planned economic and monetary union (EMU) this year.
"1997 is going to be a very important year in order to meet the Maastricht criteria, and we will actually make it," he told a news conference.
"It would be a catastrophe if Austria were not in EMU," the finance minister added.

Klima earlier projected Austria's 1997 budget deficit at 68 billion schillings, or 2.7 percent of gross domestic product, well within the three percent deficit threshold stipulated by the Maastricht Treaty for membership in EMU.
Candidates for EMU membership are scheduled to be selected in spring 1998 on the basis of 1997 economic performance. -- Vienna newsroom, +431 53112 274
